description: BattMo is the Battery Modelling Toolbox team's MATLAB environment for coupled electrochemical and thermal simulations. It contains a pseudo-X-dimensional implementation of the Doyle-Fuller-Newman lithium-ion cell model, with one-, two- and three-dimensional geometries supported through MRST. Inputs define cell geometry, material and operating assumptions; outputs describe simulated electrochemical and thermal behaviour. Spatial resolution and simulation duration are chosen for each device and experiment. Source is free under GPL-3.0, but the MATLAB runtime has separate terms. The repository supplies examples, documentation and solver dependencies. A limitation is that metal-air batteries, electrolyzers and fuel cells are development plans, not established capabilities in this README. The installation guidance expects a recent MATLAB version. BattMo supports storage-design and battery-operation simulations and relates to PyBaMM (platform-pybamm). No battery model was run or package downloaded.
name: BattMo electrochemical modelling toolbox
